description: This Java class 'ModelPermission' defines a model for handling permissions within the OFBiz service framework, including permission evaluation logic, service invocation, and permission attributes.

classes.name: ModelPermission
classes.description: Represents a permission model for services, including permission evaluation and service invocation.

methods.name: evalPermission
methods.description: Evaluates if the permission is granted based on permission type, invoking appropriate checks or services.

methods.name: evalSimplePermission
methods.description: Checks simple permission based on a permission name or role.

methods.name: evalEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks entity permission with specified action.

methods.name: evalPermissionService
methods.description: Invokes a specified permission service to evaluate permission.

methods.name: setPermissionServiceName
methods.description: Sets the name of the permission service.

methods.name: setPermissionMainAction
methods.description: Sets the main action for permission.

methods.name: setPermissionResourceDesc
methods.description: Sets the resource description for permission.

methods.name: setPermissionRequireNewTransaction
methods.description: Sets whether permission check requires a new transaction.

methods.name: setPermissionReturnErrorOnFailure
methods.description: Sets whether to return error on permission failure.

methods.name: setNameOrRole
methods.description: Sets the name or role for permission.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Gets the action associated with the permission.
